sequence_points.name: Winter Landscape with Snow-Covered Field
sequence_points.description: A landscape painting depicting a snow-covered field with tall, dry grasses in the foreground and a distant treeline under a pale blue sky. The scene is rendered in soft, muted tones of white, beige, and brown, suggesting a cold, serene winter atmosphere.

sequence_points.name: Landscape with River and Buildings
sequence_points.description: A blurred painting depicting a river scene with buildings along the banks, rendered in muted tones of blue, gray, and white. The composition suggests an urban riverside view, possibly at dusk or dawn, mounted on a museum wall.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Earth Tones
sequence_points.description: A cropped view of an abstract painting featuring blended earthy tones including browns, ochres, and muted reds. The composition appears textured with visible brushwork, suggesting a dynamic interplay of color and form.
